sources.notes: Reviews context-aware privacy strategies for EHR use with LLMs, including de-identification, differential privacy, federated learning, synthetic data, and local deployment.

sources.title: Privacy Challenges and Solutions in Retrieval-Augmented Generation-Enhanced LLMs for Healthcare Chatbots: A Review of Applications, Risks, and Future Directions
sources.notes: Reviews healthcare RAG privacy risks across storage, transmission, retrieval, and generation. Preprint; use as supporting rather than authoritative evidence.

sources.title: Uptake of Generative AI Integrated With Electronic Health Records in US Hospitals
sources.notes: Survey of 2,174 U.S. hospitals: 31.5% reported current generative AI use in 2024 and 24.7% planned adoption within one year; adoption and evaluation capabilities varied by institutional characteristics.
